node.title: M720 local n=16 small-gate replay
node.statement: The M720 full_census arithmetic reproduces the locally cheap n=16 gate facts: full_census(16,3,17)=352 trades, full_census(16,3,97)=16 trades, and full_census(16,4,17)=120 non-toral plus 6 toral.
node.attack_surface: exact standalone replay of the n=16 gate rows using the same elementary-signature definitions as modal_midlarge_h7_20.py
node.falsifier: a local exact replay of any n=16 gate row returning a different count
